notes.title: Patch 04: QoL, UI and Save System
notes.content:
Hello Chefs!
It’s with great happiness that we’re deploying a new patch! [b]Huge improvements[/b] were made on user interfaces, quality of life, balancing and animations, as well as a lot of bug fixing, including repairing the save system, and [b]new content[/b]!

You can read below a list of the changes. There are many others that you may or may not notice, but they should make your experience on Chef Life all the better!

[h2]MAJOR CHANGES[/h2]
[h3]IMPROVED SAVE SYSTEM[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed bugs
[*] optimized save file size
[*] more auto-saves during the tutorial
[*] new popup warning the player they'll lose progression if they quit during service[/list]
[h3]QUICK START[/h3]
[b]You can now skip the tutorial.[/b]

[h3]SMOOTHER DAILY FLOW[/h3]
A shortcut in the market allows you to automatically make the same food order as the previous one.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/d29a08d1ffc2f3cfc832ef862abbb85e645d0252.jpg[/img]
You can also load the same basket as the day before. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/dd6c9f6af57173dbed929fb89021c5898030e34b.png[/img]
[h3]BETTER QUEST WORKFLOW[/h3]
There’s now markers to quest-related recipes on the research table and recipe book. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/30a856985ab95b352ce2374267f227410c08cedb.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Quest markers are displayed if a recipe needs to be leveled up to complete a quest
[*] You can filter recipes out recipes not needed in quests
[*] They're displayed on the preparation table so you now know exactly what to give to your brigade
[*] New feedback to show the progress of brigade members' levels
[/list]
[h3]REWORKED THE WARMKEEPER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Heat lamps are now a separate station from the warmkeeper
[*] The warmkeeper allows you to store a wider variety of dishes
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/24e4d96499356afbd9fd0bb28cf3997a218df7bb.jpg[/img]
[h3]IMPROVED THE DRESSING EDITOR[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resize all ingredients that you've already dropped
[*] Improved interface and feedback
[*] Only 300 personalized plating max. New feedback to find the extra plating in the editor index
[*] Only variants compatible with the dish are displayed
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/2d9b82c5d09c98b0f181fbaa259fcc1ed695a5fb.jpg[/img]
[h3]NEW PHOTO MODE FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] More backgrounds colours
[*] New decorations, with different moods
[*] Interface had been reworked to offer better readability
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/c4a08cccc083df918e76476fcdb709ef1dbad78b.jpg[/img]
[h3]BETTER DIALOGUES & NPCs[/h3]
[list]
[*] New animations and visual effects to enhance dialogue events
[*] Improved NPC animation and camera movement when they arrive in the restaurant
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/d002e7edbe66521a79112d7a859292c4aa948b38.jpg[/img]
[h3]BETTER MAPPING[/h3]
[list]
[*] More interfaces are now clickable (PC only)
[*] Reworked the cutting board
[*] Reworked the meat slicer 
[*] Improved rumble features
[*] Tweaked controls
[/list]
[h3]IMPROVED RECIPE BOOK[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the interface for readability
[*] Better sorting to find recipes by their status : new, still learning able to be leveled up
[*] You can filter recipes needed for quests
[*] Easily identify recipes that are currently being learnt
[*] The minimum/maximum grade a craft can get is displayed
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/dfdd38cb2e20e005c979cb845e6f1cab8a89ad04.png[/img]
[h3]ACCESSIBILITY & COMFORT OPTIONS[/h3]
Added an Accessibility menu:
[list]
[*] Change subtitle size
[*] Toggle the HOLD action on mandatory inputs
[*] Can display longer the barks
[*] Display a voice indicator
[*] Turn off background animation during dialogues[/list] In the "preferences" menu: select automatic techniques[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/0d3e38a6a91c44c31832eac53962b4dae20180c0.png[/img]
[h3]CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION[/h3]
[list]
[*] New appearances
[*] New haircuts
[*] New beards and mustaches...
[*] and above all... you can now wear glasses!
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/a3849772f6ec3d7e14d74a328399d94ed0e2cd0e.jpg[/img]
[h3]LAYOUT AND BUILD[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reorganized sections
[*] Improved UI
[*] Room capacity of each layout is clearer
[*] Workstation capacity is now displayed
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/07db6741b9875203e17a1b359fa8a8b447e67d0b.png[/img]
[h3]BOOMBOX[/h3]
[b]Added a boombox, allowing you to change the background music.[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/c380f6acf852c00a9cb5c26a270dfa24bd4d9418.jpg[/img]
[h3]OTHER CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sous-chefs’ wheel provides information about who does what
[*] Tags are displayed on the recipes on the research table
[*] Money gained is displayed on the character
[*] Better sorting in fridges to find food by their categories
[*] Better sorting on the shipping table during service
[*] Improved research table interface
[*] Improved certain workstations' visuals
[*] Restaurant menu is more intuitive to use
[*] Improved different interfaces for clarity and dynamism 
[*] Improved some recipes' final designs 
[*] Some craft icons has been changed for consistency
[*] Fixed and balanced recipes that can be kept in the fridge
[*] Fixed and balanced other recipes
[*] Balanced and fixed some events
[*] Improved and fixed sous-chefs' behaviors
[*] Added an open/closed sign on the restaurant entrance
[*] Better feedback to understand what needs to be shipped during daytime for quests
[*] Shortcut to change all wall lamps with one button [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993947/f570f5947de4b14615193824aae8d3a32c0b3a07.png[/img]
[*] Steam Deck optimization
[*] Many others fixes
[/list]

We hope this update will provide the answers to the important feedback you’ve been giving us in the past months. We want to thank you for your patience and your cooperation, allowing us to improve Chef Life.

Have fun in the kitchen!

notes.title: Post-Launch Patch — Fixed Your Blender Chef!
notes.content:
Greetings Chefs,

[h3]We've just released a new patch for Chef Life on PC, containing a lot of requested fixes and updates on certain mechanics. Here's the full list:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed the soft block issue with the blender and the mixing table.
[*] Tweaked mouse sensitivity options.
[*] Preheating or boiling water won't remove points if it's not a criteria.
[*] Added help for cooking the "perfect steak" during the tutorial.
[*] Tweaked the tutorial to avoid soft blocks.
[*] Kassim can prepare more complex food sooner.
[*] Balanced dish pricing.
[*] "Give Order" input is always available during services.
[*] Fixed the cursor randomly disappearing.
[*] Better food products are available sooner.
[*] Decoration mode should not soft block the player character anymore.
[*] Fixed following recipes: Cordon Bleu, Tartare, Seafood Spaghetti.
[*] Fixed the "Chef, Oui Chef!" achievement.
[/list]

An other fix for your team members' quests will be coming early next week.

We want to thank all of you for your patience and cooperation. Your feedback is always appreciated and helps us tweak the game to make it a great experience. We hope you're enjoying Chef Life and that this update will bring much desired changes.

If any other issue arises, we're always reading your posts on the Steam forums.
You can also send us feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/4Kds38DvnQ]Discord server[/url].

SIncerely,
The development & publishing team.

notes.title: I'm so into this chef sim I've got mushrooms tattooed on my arm
notes.content: When you're a chef, attractively plating a meal is almost as important as how the meal itself tastes. Is that true? I have no idea: I am not a chef and I should definitely not be allowed to plate meals. The first time I tried it in Chef Life: A Restaurant Simulator it was a disaster. The cooking and restaurant management sim lets you not only prepare meals but place every last thing on the plate manually before you serve them: meat, vegetables, sides, garnish, even the sauces... Read more.
